title: Set triggers and filters
blurb: Control exactly who enters a workflow and when.

steps.title: Open a workflow
steps.body: Click the workflow you want to change, or create a new one.

steps.title: Add a trigger
steps.body: Click **Add New Trigger**. Use the search box to find one fast, for example **Form Submitted**, **Contact Tag** or **Appointment Status**.

steps.title: Narrow it with filters
steps.body: In the trigger panel, add filters so only the right people get in. For example, only one form, only one calendar, or only when a certain tag is added.
steps.tip: No filter means every matching event starts the workflow. Double-check before publishing.

steps.title: Use more than one trigger
steps.body: Add extra triggers if several things should start the same workflow, like a website form and a Facebook lead form. Any one of them will start it.

steps.title: Save the trigger
steps.body: Click **Save Trigger**, then **Save** at the top of the workflow.
